note: Container platform vendor. Broad upstream coverage; upstream whitelists are adjusted without notice.

name: 1ms.run
note: Commercial acceleration service with a free public tier. Blob transfers are occasionally cut off mid-read, which the probe records as a failed throughput rather than smoothing over.

name: hub.rat.dev
note: Little public information about the operator. It answers by redirecting to docker.1ms.run, so it behaves like that mirror and stands or falls with it. Listed because people use it, not because it is recommended.
